svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.11.9 Attachment to Decking
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING

g.text: Roofing securely attached to the decking, (1)
ORDER WHERE INSULATION IS ABOVE THE DECK
1. The insulation is securely attached to the deck.
2. Then the first layer of felt is fastened to the insulation.

svg.text: Roofing is securely attached to the decking or
where insulation is applied above the deck,
the insulation is securely attached to the
deck before the first layer of felt is
The Article does not set the fastener type or spacing: fasteners shown as round heads and plates, illustration only.
